codeListLookup.title: Codelist Lookup
codeListLookup.description: Human-readable titles looked up from 360Giving codelists for coded fields present on the grant.

toIndividualsDetails.title: To Individuals Details
toIndividualsDetails.description: Codelist titles for grants to individuals.

locationLookup.title: Location Lookup
locationLookup.description: One entry per geography source found on the grant (beneficiary location, recipient organisation location, or recipient organisation postcode), giving the ONS/geo-lookups hierarchy for that location.

areacode.title: Focal Area Code
areacode.description: ONS code for the specific geographic unit this entry represents.

areaname.title: Focal Area Name
areaname.description: Name of the specific geographic unit this entry represents.

areatype.title: Area Type
areatype.description: Level of geography represented by the focal area (e.g. lsoa, msoa, ward).

cauthcd.title: Combined Authority Code
cauthcd.description: ONS code for the Combined Authority Area.

cauthnm.title: Combined Authority Name
cauthnm.description: Name of the Combined Authority Area.

ctrycd.title: Country Code
ctrycd.description: ONS code for the constituent country.

ewcd.title: England & Wales Code
ewcd.description: ONS code for England and Wales combined.

gbcd.title: Great Britain Code
gbcd.description: ONS code for Great Britain (England, Scotland, Wales).

ladcd.title: Local Authority District Code
ladcd.description: ONS code for the district-level authority.

ladcd_active.title: Active LAD Code
ladcd_active.description: Currently active Local Authority District code.

ladnm_active.title: Active LAD Name
ladnm_active.description: Currently active Local Authority District name.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate (only present for ward-level entries).

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate (only present for ward-level entries).

lsoa11cd.title: Lower Layer Super Output Area Code (2011)
lsoa11cd.description: ONS code for the Lower Layer Super Output Area (2011 definition).

lsoa11nm.title: Lower Layer Super Output Area Name (2011)
lsoa11nm.description: Name of the Lower Layer Super Output Area (2011 definition).

lsoa21cd.title: Lower Layer Super Output Area Code (2021)
lsoa21cd.description: ONS code for the Lower Layer Super Output Area (2021 definition).

msoa11cd.title: Middle Layer Super Output Code (2011)
msoa11cd.description: ONS code for the Middle Layer Super Output Area (2011 definition).

msoa11hclnm.title: Middle Layer Super Output Area Hierarchy Classification Name (2011)
msoa11hclnm.description: Name of the hierarchical classification for the Middle Layer Super Output Area (2011 definition).

msoa11nm.title: Middle Layer Super Output Area Name (2011)
msoa11nm.description: Name of the Middle Layer Super Output Area (2011 definition).

msoacd.title: Middle Layer Super Output Code
msoacd.description: ONS code for the Middle Layer Super Output Area.

msoahclnm.title: Middle Layer Super Output Area Hierarchy Classification Name
msoahclnm.description: Name of the hierarchical classification for the Middle Layer Super Output Area.

msoanm.title: Middle Layer Super Output Area Name
msoanm.description: Name of the Middle Layer Super Output Area.

rgncd.title: Region Code
rgncd.description: ONS code for the Government Office Region.

rgnnm.title: Region Name
rgnnm.description: Name of the Government Office Region.

source.title: 360Giving Source Field
source.description: The 360Giving data field this lookup entry was derived from, e.g. beneficiaryLocation, recipientOrganizationLocation, recipientOrganizationPostcode.

sourceCode.title: 360Giving Source Value
sourceCode.description: The geo code (e.g. postcode-derived LSOA, or geoCode) that was looked up to produce this entry.

ukcd.title: UK Code
ukcd.description: ONS code for the United Kingdom.

utlacd.title: Upper Tier Local Authority Code
utlacd.description: ONS code for the county-level authority.

locationLookup.x-derivedFrom: beneficiaryLocation[].geoCode (when source=beneficiaryLocation), recipientOrganization[].location[].geoCode (when source=recipientOrganizationLocation), or recipientOrganization[].postalCode (when source=recipientOrganizationPostcode) - see this entry's own source field

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Licensing metadata for the grant's source file and for each additional_data source used.

source_license.title: Source License URL
source_license.description: License URL for the publisher's original data file.

source_license_name.title: Source License Name
source_license_name.description: License name for the publisher's original data file.

sources_metadata.title: Sources Metadata
sources_metadata.description: License information for each additional_data source that contributed to this grant.

recipientCountryName.title: Recipient Country Name
recipientCountryName.description: Best-available country name for the recipient, taken from the first locationLookup entry. Kept for backward compatibility with GrantNav.

recipientDistrictGeoCode.title: Recipient District Geo Code
recipientDistrictGeoCode.description: Best-available district (Local Authority District) geo code for the recipient, taken from the first locationLookup entry.

recipientDistrictName.title: Recipient District Name
recipientDistrictName.description: Best-available district (Local Authority District) name for the recipient, taken from the first locationLookup entry.

recipientLocation.title: Recipient Location
recipientLocation.description: Human-readable summary combining the recipient's district, district geo code and region.

recipientOrganizationLocation.title: Recipient Organisation Location
recipientOrganizationLocation.description: NSPL (National Statistics Postcode Lookup) record for the recipient organisation's postcode.

bua22.title: Built-up Area Code
bua22.description: ONS code for the Built-up Area (2022 definition).

bua22_name.title: Built-up Area Name
bua22_name.description: Name of the Built-up Area (2022 definition).

ced.title: County Electoral Division Code
ced.description: ONS code for the county electoral division.

cty.title: County Code
cty.description: ONS code for the county or metropolitan county.

doterm.title: Date of Termination
doterm.description: Date the postcode was terminated (if applicable).

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: Hash of the NSPL lookup result for this postcode, used by datastore to detect changes.

icb.title: Integrated Care Board Code
icb.description: ONS code for the Integrated Care Board.

icb_name.title: Integrated Care Board Name
icb_name.description: Name of the Integrated Care Board.

imd.title: Index of Multiple Deprivation Rank
imd.description: Rank of the area on the Index of Multiple Deprivation (lower = more deprived).

itl.title: International Territorial Level Code
itl.description: ONS code for the International Territorial Level area.

itl_name.title: International Territorial Level Name
itl_name.description: Name of the International Territorial Level area.

laua.title: Local Authority District Code
laua.description: ONS code for the local authority district.

laua_name.title: Local Authority District Name
laua_name.description: Name of the local authority district.

lep1.title: Local Enterprise Partnership Code (Primary)
lep1.description: ONS code for the primary Local Enterprise Partnership.

lep1_name.title: Local Enterprise Partnership Name (Primary)
lep1_name.description: Name of the primary Local Enterprise Partnership.

lep2.title: Local Enterprise Partnership Code (Secondary)
lep2.description: ONS code for the secondary Local Enterprise Partnership (if applicable).

lsoa21.title: Lower Layer Super Output Area Code (2021)
lsoa21.description: ONS code for the 2021 Lower Layer Super Output Area.

lsoa21_name.title: Lower Layer Super Output Area Name (2021)
lsoa21_name.description: Name of the 2021 Lower Layer Super Output Area.

msoa21.title: Middle Layer Super Output Area Code (2021)
msoa21.description: ONS code for the 2021 Middle Layer Super Output Area.

msoa21_name.title: Middle Layer Super Output Area Name (2021)
msoa21_name.description: Name of the 2021 Middle Layer Super Output Area.

nhser.title: NHS England Region Code
nhser.description: ONS code for the NHS England region.

nhser_name.title: NHS England Region Name
nhser_name.description: Name of the NHS England region.

npark.title: National Park Code
npark.description: ONS code for the National Park area (if applicable).

npark_name.title: National Park Name
npark_name.description: Name of the National Park area (if applicable).

oa21.title: Output Area Code (2021)
oa21.description: ONS code for the 2021 Output Area.

oac11.title: Output Area Classification (2011)
oac11.description: Output Area Classification category for the location.

oseast1m.title: Ordnance Survey Easting Coordinate
oseast1m.description: Ordnance Survey easting coordinate in metres.

osgrdind.title: Ordnance Survey Grid Indicator
osgrdind.description: Indicator for the Ordnance Survey grid reference.

osnrth1m.title: Ordnance Survey Northing Coordinate
osnrth1m.description: Ordnance Survey northing coordinate in metres.

pcds.title: Postcode (Space-separated)
pcds.description: Postcode with space between outward and inward codes.

pcon.title: Parliamentary Constituency Code
pcon.description: ONS code for the parliamentary constituency.

pfa.title: Police Force Area Code
pfa.description: ONS code for the police force area.

pfa_name.title: Police Force Area Name
pfa_name.description: Name of the police force area.

ru11ind.title: Rural Urban Indicator (2011)
ru11ind.description: Classification of whether the area is urban or rural.

sicbl.title: Sub-Integrated Care Board Location Code
sicbl.description: ONS code for the Sub-Integrated Care Board area.

sicbl_name.title: Sub-Integrated Care Board Location Name
sicbl_name.description: Name of the Sub-Integrated Care Board area.

ttwa.title: Travel to Work Area Code
ttwa.description: ONS code for the Travel to Work Area.

ttwa_name.title: Travel to Work Area Name
ttwa_name.description: Name of the Travel to Work Area.

usertype.title: User Type
usertype.description: Indicator of whether the postcode is a small or large user postcode.

ward.title: Ward Code
ward.description: ONS code for the electoral ward.

wz11.title: Workplace Zone Code (2011)
wz11.description: ONS code for the 2011 Workplace Zone.

recipientOrgInfos.title: Recipient Org Info
recipientOrgInfos.description: Organisation records matched from Find that Charity for the recipient organisation's 360Giving identifier.

active.title: Is Active
active.description: Whether the organisation is currently active.

dateModified.title: Date Modified
dateModified.description: Date this Find that Charity record was last modified.

dateRemoved.title: Date Removed
dateRemoved.description: Date the organisation was removed from its register, if applicable.

latestIncomeDate.title: Latest Income Date
latestIncomeDate.description: Date of the most recently reported income.

linked_orgs.title: Linked Organisations
linked_orgs.description: Other organisation identifiers Find that Charity links to this organisation.

linked_orgs_verified.title: Linked Organisations (Verified)
linked_orgs_verified.description: Verified subset of linked organisation identifiers.

name.title: Recipient Organisation Name
name.description: Organisation name as recorded by Find that Charity.

organisationType.title: Organisation Type
organisationType.description: All organisation type categories recorded for this organisation.

orgIDs.title: Organisation Identifiers
orgIDs.description: All known identifiers for this organisation.

postalCode.title: Postal Code
postalCode.description: Registered postal code for the organisation.

source.title: Source
source.description: Which Find that Charity source register this record came from, e.g. ccew (Charity Commission for England and Wales).

recipientRegionName.title: Recipient Region Name
recipientRegionName.description: Best-available region name for the recipient, taken from the first locationLookup entry. Falls back to country name for Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland, which don't have a region.

TSGFundingOrgType.title: 360Giving Funding Organisation Type
TSGFundingOrgType.description: ThreeSixtyGiving's own classification of the funding organisation's type, assigned by matching the funder's identifier against a set of curated rules.

TSGRecipientType.title: 360Giving Recipient Type
TSGRecipientType.description: Whether the recipient is an Organisation or an Individual.

recipientWardName.title: Ward Name
recipientWardName.description: Electoral ward name for the recipient organisation, from its registered postcode. Only available for the recipient organisation, not the beneficiary, since it needs postcode-level granularity.

recipientWardNameGeoCode.title: Ward Name Geo Code
recipientWardNameGeoCode.description: ONS code for the recipient organisation's electoral ward.

GNCanonicalRecipientOrgName.title: Recipient Org: Canonical Name
GNCanonicalRecipientOrgName.description: GrantNav's canonical (deduplicated/merged) name for the recipient organisation, computed in GrantNav from its own organisation-matching data; falls back to the grant's own recipientOrganization[0].name if no canonical match is found.

GNCanonicalRecipientOrgId.title: Recipient Org: Canonical Org ID
GNCanonicalRecipientOrgId.description: GrantNav's canonical organisation identifier for the recipient organisation, computed in GrantNav from its own organisation-matching data; falls back to recipientOrganization[0].id if no canonical match is found.

GNCanonicalFundingOrgName.title: Funding Org: Canonical Name
GNCanonicalFundingOrgName.description: GrantNav's canonical (deduplicated/merged) name for the funding organisation, computed in GrantNav from its own organisation-matching data; falls back to the grant's own fundingOrganization[0].name if no canonical match is found.

GNCanonicalFundingOrgId.title: Funding Org: Canonical Org ID
GNCanonicalFundingOrgId.description: GrantNav's canonical organisation identifier for the funding organisation, computed in GrantNav from its own organisation-matching data; falls back to fundingOrganization[0].id if no canonical match is found.

GNRecipientOrgInfo0.title: Recipient Org Info (First Match)
GNRecipientOrgInfo0.description: Convenience fields computed from the first entry of recipientOrgInfos.

ageWhenAwarded.title: Recipient Org Age When Awarded
ageWhenAwarded.description: How old the recipient organisation was at the grant's awardDate, bucketed into bands (e.g. "1-2 years"), computed from awardDate minus recipientOrgInfos[0].dateRegistered.

GNRecipientOrgCountryName.title: Recipient Org Country Name
GNRecipientOrgCountryName.description: Recipient organisation's country name, from locationLookup entries with source recipientOrganizationLocation/recipientOrganizationPostcode (falling back to codeListLookup.recipientOrg_location_countryCode, and to "United Kingdom" if the location is within the UK & NI).

GNBeneficiaryCountryName.title: Beneficiary Country Name
GNBeneficiaryCountryName.description: Beneficiary's country name, from locationLookup entries with source beneficiaryLocation (falling back to codeListLookup.beneficiaryLocation_countryCode, and to "United Kingdom" if the location is within the UK & NI).

GNBeneficiaryDistrictName.title: Beneficiary District
GNBeneficiaryDistrictName.description: Beneficiary's district (Local Authority District) name, from the locationLookup entry with source beneficiaryLocation.

GNBeneficiaryDistrictGeoCode.title: Beneficiary District Geographic code
GNBeneficiaryDistrictGeoCode.description: ONS code for the beneficiary's district, from the locationLookup entry with source beneficiaryLocation.

GNBeneficiaryCountyName.title: Beneficiary County
GNBeneficiaryCountyName.description: Beneficiary's county (Upper Tier Local Authority) name, from the locationLookup entry with source beneficiaryLocation.

GNBeneficiaryRegionName.title: Beneficiary Region
GNBeneficiaryRegionName.description: Beneficiary's region name, from the locationLookup entry with source beneficiaryLocation. Falls back to country name for Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland, which don't have a region.

GNBeneficiaryRegionGeoCode.title: Beneficiary Region Geographic code
GNBeneficiaryRegionGeoCode.description: ONS code for the beneficiary's region (or country, where a nation has no region), from the locationLookup entry with source beneficiaryLocation.

GNRecipientOrgCountyName.title: Recipient County
GNRecipientOrgCountyName.description: Recipient organisation's county (Upper Tier Local Authority) name, from locationLookup entries with source recipientOrganizationLocation/recipientOrganizationPostcode.

GNRecipientOrgDistrictName.title: Recipient District
GNRecipientOrgDistrictName.description: Recipient organisation's district (Local Authority District) name, from locationLookup entries with source recipientOrganizationLocation/recipientOrganizationPostcode.

GNRecipientOrgDistrictGeoCode.title: Recipient District Geographic code
GNRecipientOrgDistrictGeoCode.description: ONS code for the recipient organisation's district, from locationLookup entries with source recipientOrganizationLocation/recipientOrganizationPostcode.

GNRecipientOrgRegionName.title: Recipient Region
GNRecipientOrgRegionName.description: Recipient organisation's region name, from locationLookup entries with source recipientOrganizationLocation/recipientOrganizationPostcode. Falls back to country name for Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland, which don't have a region.

GNRecipientOrgRegionGeoCode.title: Recipient Region Geographic code
GNRecipientOrgRegionGeoCode.description: ONS code for the recipient organisation's region (or country, where a nation has no region), from locationLookup entries with source recipientOrganizationLocation/recipientOrganizationPostcode.

recipientOrganizationCanonical.title: Recipient Org: Canonical
recipientOrganizationCanonical.description: Canonical recipient organisation identifier/name from an older, pre-refactor version of GrantNav's org-matching (superseded by GNCanonicalRecipientOrgId/Name). Not produced by current code; still present on documents indexed before that refactor.

fundingOrganizationCanonical.title: Funding Org: Canonical
fundingOrganizationCanonical.description: Canonical funding organisation identifier/name from an older, pre-refactor version of GrantNav's org-matching (superseded by GNCanonicalFundingOrgId/Name). Not produced by current code; still present on documents indexed before that refactor.
